_comment: notifybridge config shipped with the led_hal_root module. Deployed to /data/local/tmp/notifybridge.json by customize.sh (module install) and install_core.cmd (dev apply). Sections: notifications (out for ENQ/CAN/RING/VOIP/MISSED; the dialer package is fully classified by the bridge - live calls as RING, missed tombstones as MISSED - and never emitted as a raw ENQ), broadcasts (screen polarity + snapshot replay + battery charge state), settings (the 'Blink light' gate: Settings.System.notification_light_pulse forwarded as PULSE 0/1 instantly, current polarity replayed to every socket on connect like screen). Wire contract to the daemon: ENQ/CAN/RING_ON/OFF/VOIP_ON/OFF/MISSED_ON/OFF/SCREEN 0|1/CHG <status> <level>/PULSE 0|1.

broadcasts._comment: SCREEN keeps the pre-hardcode behavior alive: polarity gives a real $on bit, snapshot re-emits the current screen state on socket connect (replacement for the old built-in replay).

BATTERY_CHANGED carries the whole charge state (level + status + plugged) and fires on every real step: capacity change while charging, plug/unplug transitions. Routed to the daemon as CHG <status> <level> <plugged> - the daemon reads NOTHING from sysfs and owns no polling. No snapshot here: registering the receiver delivers the current sticky state by itself, and the reconnect replay would only emit an un-substituted template line.

settings._comment: Blink light gate: forward Settings.System.notification_light_pulse changes to the daemon as PULSE 0/1.
settings.name: notification_light_pulse
